question: Is spatially varying inverse-render vertex albedo the dominant cause of held-out interior edge error?
hypothesis: Replacing only the solved spatial vertex albedo with its solved mean, while holding geometry, camera, measured environment, BRDF and exposure fixed, reduces interior edge error by at least 10% on both held-out views.

intervention.counterfactual: same solved mean RGB assigned to every vertex

acceptance.supported: flat albedo lowers interior edge score by >=10% on both held-out views
acceptance.falsified: flat albedo does not lower interior edge score by >=10% on both held-out views
